exposure: distance from placenta to cervical os
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with low-lying placenta (placenta edge within 20 mm of internal os on transvaginal sonography) delivered at a single hospital from 2002 to 2012, excluding suspected placenta accreta and vasa previa.
finding: While low-lying placenta does not preclude vaginal delivery, it is associated with a significant risk of bleeding complications, irrespective of the intended mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Placenta-os distance did not significantly affect outcomes in this series.
